title: In vitro transcription of DIG-labelled RNA probe
author: Ida Barlow
license_note: Confirmed via CrossRef DOI metadata: dx.doi.org/10.17504/protocols.io.ba4pigvn

steps.title: Prepare 5 mM DIG‑NTP mix (10X)
steps.instruction: Combine the following reagents on ice to make the 5 mM DIG‑NTP mix (10X): 2 µL of 5 mM DIG‑NTP mix, 2 µL of 100 mM CTP, 2 µL of 100 mM GTP, 1.3 µL of 100 mM ATP, 7 µL of 100 mM UTP, 25.7 µL of 10 mM DIG‑11‑UTP, and add nuclease‑free water to reach the intended total volume.

steps.title: Assemble transcription reaction on ice
steps.instruction: In a chilled tube, add the following components in the order listed, then bring the total volume to 20 µL with nuclease‑free water: 2 µL DTT, 0.5 µL 10X DIG‑NTP mix (5 mM), 2 µL RNase inhibitor, 1 µg 10X transcription buffer, 1 µL linearised template, the RNA polymerase as supplied, 2 µL of the prepared 5 mM DIG‑NTP mix (10X), and any remaining nuclease‑free water to reach 20 µL.

substeps.instruction: Add 2 µL prepared 5 mM DIG‑NTP mix (10X).
Adjust volume to 20 µL with nuclease‑free water.

steps.title: Mix reaction gently
steps.instruction: Mix the assembled reaction by gently flicking the tube and then briefly spin down the contents.

steps.title: Incubate transcription at 37 °C
steps.instruction: Place the tube at 37 °C and incubate for 2 hours (02:00:00).

steps.title: Add DNase I and digest template
steps.instruction: Add 1 µL DNase I to the reaction and incubate at 37 °C for 15 minutes (00:15:00) to digest the DNA template.

steps.title: Purify RNA and assess quality
steps.instruction: Purify the transcribed RNA using the ZYMO RNA Cleanup Kit, then evaluate RNA integrity by agarose gel electrophoresis and determine concentration with a Nanodrop spectrophotometer.

substeps.instruction: Perform RNA purification with the ZYMO RNA Cleanup Kit according to the manufacturer’s protocol.
Run an aliquot on an agarose gel to check RNA quality.
Measure RNA concentration using a Nanodrop spectrophotometer.
